question: Which of the following programs aims at self-employment for the rural poor? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: National Rural Health Mission
Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana

Explanation:
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana (DAY) aims to provide self-employment opportunities to the rural poor. This scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development and is based on the philosophy of Deendayal Upadhyaya. Under DAY, Self Help Groups (SHGs) are promoted and provided with skill training and financial assistance. Other options: National Rural Health Mission focuses on health services, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana provides housing, and Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) guarantees wage employment, not self-employment.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Objective of Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana → Providing self-employment to rural poor
☛ Implementing ministry of DAY → Ministry of Rural Development
☛ Key components of DAY → Self Help Groups and skill training
☛ Former name of DAY → Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana
☛ Objective of MGNREGA → Ensuring 100 days of wage employment to rural households
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य ग्रामीण निर्धनों के लिए स्वरोजगार प्रदान करना है? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 3)
options_hi: राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण स्वास्थ्य मिशन
प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना
दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना
महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना

Explanation:
दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना (DAY) का उद्देश्य ग्रामीण गरीबों को स्वरोजगार के अवसर प्रदान करना है। यह योजना ग्रामीण विकास मंत्रालय द्वारा कार्यान्वित की जाती है और इसमें दीनदयाल उपाध्याय के अंत्योदय दर्शन को अपनाया गया है। DAY के तहत स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) को बढ़ावा दिया जाता है और उन्हें कौशल प्रशिक्षण व वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है। अन्य विकल्प: राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण स्वास्थ्य मिशन स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं से संबंधित है, प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना आवास प्रदान करती है, और महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA) मजदूरी रोजगार गारंटी देता है, स्वरोजगार नहीं।

question: Which central government scheme is primarily aimed at providing road connectivity to rural and remote areas in India? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (27/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
Setu Bharatam Scheme
Bharatmala Pariyojana
Rural Infrastructure Development Fund
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana

Explanation:
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) was launched in the year 2000. Its primary objective is to provide road connectivity to rural and remote areas in India. This scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development. Under PMGSY, habitations with a population of more than 500 (250 in hilly areas) are connected with all-weather roads. The funding is shared between the central and state governments. PMGSY also contributes to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Among other options, Setu Bharatam focuses on bridge maintenance, Bharatmala is a highway development program, and Rural Infrastructure Development Fund is managed by NABARD for rural infrastructure.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full name of PMGSY? → Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
☛ When was PMGSY launched? → 2000
☛ Which ministry implements PMGSY? → Ministry of Rural Development
☛ What is the population threshold for villages under PMGSY? → 500 (250 in hilly areas)
☛ What is the main objective of PMGSY? → To provide road connectivity to rural areas
question_hi: केंद्र सरकार की किस योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य भारत में ग्रामीण और दूरदराज के क्षेत्रों को सड़क संपर्क प्रदान करना है? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (27/03/2026) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following programmes aims to increase soil fertility and thereby helps in production of healthy food through organic practices without the use of agro-chemicals? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (25/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
Pradhan Mantri Kisan MaanDhan Yojana
Rastriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana

Explanation:
Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) was launched in 2015 to promote organic farming without the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. It aims to increase soil fertility through organic practices, thereby producing healthy food. Under this scheme, farmers are organized into clusters and provided support for certification and training. Other options like Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana relates to crop insurance, Pradhan Mantri Kisan MaanDhan Yojana provides old-age pension, and Rastriya Krishi Vikas Yojana is for overall agricultural development.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of PKVY? → Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
☛ Which ministry implements PKVY? → Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
☛ What is the objective of PKVY? → To promote organic farming and increase soil fertility
☛ What assistance is provided to farmers under PKVY? → Organic certification and training
☛ How many farmers are in a cluster under PKVY? → 50 farmers

question: Which scheme launched in 2000 aims at reducing rural poverty by increasing rural connectivity? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (17/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: Swaranjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana
Bharatmala Pariyojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana

Explanation:
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) is a centrally sponsored scheme launched in 2000. Its primary objective is to reduce rural poverty by providing all-weather road connectivity to unconnected villages in rural India. Improved road connectivity facilitates better access to markets, healthcare, education, and employment opportunities, thereby enhancing the economic condition of rural populations. The scheme focuses on connecting eligible habitations with a population of 250-500 or more as per census data. PMGSY has significantly improved rural infrastructure and contributed to poverty alleviation by enabling smoother transportation of agricultural produce and reducing isolation of remote areas.

☛ Full form of PMGSY → Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
☛ Key objective of PMGSY → Rural connectivity to reduce poverty
☛ Type of scheme → Centrally Sponsored Scheme
☛ Matching centrally sponsored scheme for rural road connectivity → PMGSY

question: During recession, which type of Fiscal Policy should be used? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (17/03/2026) Shift 1)
options: Stable Fiscal Policy
Expansionary Fiscal Policy
Contractionary Fiscal Policy
Neutral Fiscal Policy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Expansionary Fiscal Policy

Explanation:
During a recession, the economy experiences a decline in aggregate demand, leading to reduced output and employment. To counter this, the government adopts an expansionary fiscal policy, which involves increasing government spending and/or decreasing taxes to stimulate aggregate demand. Higher government expenditure directly boosts demand, while tax cuts leave more disposable income with consumers and businesses, encouraging consumption and investment. This policy aims to increase economic activity, reduce unemployment, and help the economy recover from the recession. Thus, expansionary fiscal policy is the appropriate response to a recessionary gap.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Fiscal policy used during recession → Expansionary
☛ Measures of expansionary policy → Increase government spending and decrease taxes
☛ Policy used during inflation → Contractionary fiscal policy
☛ Goal of expansionary policy → Increase aggregate demand
☛ Types of fiscal policy → Expansionary, Contractionary, Neutral

question: Stand Up India Scheme was launched in which of the following years? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: 2014
2019
2015
2016
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2016

Explanation:
The Stand Up India Scheme was launched on April 5, 2016. It aims to facilitate bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises. This scheme is administered under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana and focuses on promoting entrepreneurship among marginalized sections. The loan is repayable within 7 years and includes provisions for working capital.

☛ Target beneficiaries → SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs

☛ Objective → Promote entrepreneurship and employment generation

question: In which year was the Padhe Bharat Badhe Bharat (PBBB) scheme launched? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (17/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: 2014
2007
2010
2018
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2014

Explanation:
The Padhe Bharat Badhe Bharat (PBBB) scheme was launched in 2014. It is a national-level initiative aimed at developing basic literacy and numeracy skills among children in early grades, specifically Classes 1 and 2. The scheme is implemented under the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan and focuses on helping children acquire foundational reading, writing, and arithmetic skills. The primary goal is to ensure that all children achieve foundational literacy and numeracy by the time they reach Class 3. This centrally sponsored scheme is implemented across all states and union territories to ensure universal access to quality early education.

question: What is the primary purpose of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 3)
options: To provide free food to rural households
To supply subsidised agricultural inputs to farmers
To skill rural youth and promote wage employment opportunities
To offer old-age pensions in villages
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To skill rural youth and promote wage employment opportunities

Explanation:
The Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) is a national skill development scheme launched by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, on 25 September 2014. Its primary objective is to provide skill training to poor rural youth aged 15-35 years and connect them with wage employment. The scheme specifically focuses on vulnerable groups such as Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women. It guarantees job placement after training. This initiative helps reduce rural unemployment and strengthen the rural economy.

question: Which Indian government initiative has been introduced to support informal workers in urban areas? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (24/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Jal Shakti Abhiyan
PM-KISAN
PM-SVANidhi
PM Ujjwala Yojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is PM-SVANidhi

Explanation:
PM-SVANidhi (Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi) scheme was launched in June 2020. Its objective is to support informal workers in urban areas, especially street vendors, in recovering from the economic crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Under this scheme, a working capital loan of up to Rs. 10,000 is provided without any guarantee. The loan tenure is 1 year, and interest subsidy is given upon timely repayment. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs. Other options like Jal Shakti Abhiyan relate to water conservation, PM-KISAN is for farmers, and PM Ujjwala Yojana provides LPG connections.

☛ Which ministry implements PM-SVANidhi? → Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
☛ What is the full form of PM-SVANidhi? → Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
☛ Who is the target beneficiary of PM-SVANidhi? → Urban street vendors

question: What does the Food for Work Programme aim to provide to the rural poor of backward districts? (RRB NTPC GRADUATE CBT 1 (22/03/2026) Shift 3)

Free education and training abroad
Access to private healthcare schemes
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Supplementary wage employment

Explanation:
The Food for Work Programme (FWP) was initiated by the Government of India to provide supplementary wage employment to the rural poor in backward districts. Under this program, workers were paid in food grains (such as wheat or rice) instead of cash wages. It was launched in 2000-2001 and later merged with the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) in 2006. The primary objective of FWP was to ensure food security in areas affected by drought or other natural calamities and to create employment opportunities. The works undertaken included construction or repair of community assets like roads, ponds, and schools.

question: Which of the following government initiatives is specifically aimed at the conservation and protection of wildlife in India through habitat preservation and species-focused management? (RRB Paramedical (12/03/2026) Shift 2)
options: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
Operation Flood
Swachh Bharat Mission
Project Tiger
solution:

Explanation:
Project Tiger is a flagship government initiative launched in India in 1973, specifically aimed at the conservation of tigers through habitat preservation and species-focused management. Under this program, special tiger reserves are established where anti-poaching measures, habitat restoration, and community relocation are implemented. In contrast, Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana focuses on rural road connectivity, Operation Flood on dairy development, and Swachh Bharat Mission on sanitation. Therefore, only Project Tiger directly addresses wildlife conservation and habitat protection. The project is administered by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) and has been instrumental in increasing India's tiger population.
